chapter: Honors, Gibson and Dorsey late years
title: Homecoming concert in Portland, Maine
summary: Leeman returns to Portland as guest performer, meets old classmates and visits his birthplace and the Cape Elizabeth house he designed.

story.theme_name: Growing up and learning music: family, first instruments, teachers
story.community_name: Where I came from: parents, siblings and birth

blocks.x: I was the guest instrumentalist. I should say guest performer with a local group which was just wonderful, and I had a wonderful day reminiscing with a gang of old friends whom I hadn't seen for 40 or 50 years.

That gave me the opportunity to go by, they drove me by where I was born and the house I grew up in, it's still there, O'Neal Street in Portland, and they drove me out to Cape Elizabeth, Maine, where the house I had built originally, the one I designed, is still there and in beautiful condition, which sits on the 35 acres that my grandfather and father had as a 35 acre farm originally, and my father's home next door is still there -- beautifully preserved. So I just reminisced and was with all the guys that I went to school with -- and it was a wonderful experience.
